title: AI-Powered Facial Recognition Attendance System
description: Developed an AI-powered attendance system using SSD and ResNet-50 with ~95% accuracy. Implemented real-time processing with Flask-SocketIO and PostgreSQL for robust data management.

title: C.L.A.R.A. — AI-Powered Articulation Therapy Assistant
description: Ongoing final-year project developing an articulation therapy assistant. Built with Wav2Vec2, ONNX, and transfer learning. Features a FastAPI backend serving Whisper, Wav2Vec2, an LLM, vector DB, and WebSocket-based emotion detection.

title: Gladius Knives E-commerce Platform
description: Built a full-stack e-commerce platform with MERN and TypeScript. Features JWT authentication, Cloudinary integration, SSR for 40% faster load times, and an admin dashboard.

title: Spring PetClinic – DevOps Pipeline Implementation
description: Implemented a 6-stage DevOps pipeline using GitHub Actions. Provisioned AWS infrastructure using Terraform and deployed the application using Docker and Kubernetes.
